text:
Opening (20 sec): ‘A customer asks for size 42 at 11:47 p.m. The sale should not depend on whether the shop owner is awake.’ We turn the WhatsApp account merchants already use into a guided, catalog-grounded sales channel.

Transition: First, why this matters for the merchants we are building for.

Key takeaway: For WhatsApp-first SMEs, repetitive support and manual order-taking consume the same scarce owner time needed to run the business. The economic consequence is not abstract: delayed answers reduce the chance that buying intent becomes a recorded order.
Estimated time: 30 seconds.

text:
Suggested narration: ‘The customer asks in Roman Urdu for shoes. The Copilot searches this store’s catalog, not the open internet. If an image is sent, the gateway extracts attributes and still matches only against the catalog. The customer chooses size and quantity, confirms COD, and the order appears in the dashboard. At any point, the merchant can take over.’
Estimated time: 60 seconds.
Transition: The demo is backed by a deliberately scoped MVP.

text:
Key takeaway: We refuse to hide behind a giant global TAM. The immediate opportunity should be calculated from reachable merchants times a tested subscription price. Why now: conversational AI can interpret multilingual chat and media, while merchants already run sales on WhatsApp. The merchant counts and willingness-to-pay remain research questions.
Estimated time: 30 seconds.
Transition: The pricing hypothesis is designed to be tested with those pilots.

[Sources]
- User-provided brief: market framing
- No external market statistics used; all sizing fields intentionally left as research-required

Key takeaway: Subscription pricing should be anchored to time saved and orders captured, with media usage priced so cost scales safely. These PKR ranges are hypotheses for discovery interviews, not proven willingness to pay. Optional onboarding can fund catalog cleanup and setup.

text:
Key takeaway: The repository proves technical feasibility, not commercial traction or production readiness. The immediate milestone is a small set of merchant pilots with real catalogs and anonymized conversations. Avoid showing unstable items live: fresh QR pairing, external Gemini calls, uncached image matching, or anything that depends on Docker/Internet without a preflight check.
Estimated time: 45 seconds.
Transition: We know what to validate, and we know exactly what help accelerates it.

text:
Closing (25 sec): ‘Local merchants do not need another dashboard that customers never visit. They need intelligence inside the conversation where the sale already happens.’ Our ask is specific: pilot merchants, product and distribution mentorship, technical/cloud support, and early-stage conversations — no invented funding target.
Strong closing line: ‘Let’s turn the next customer message into a measurable pilot.’
Estimated time: 25 seconds.
